scope: Read-only inspection of current saved assets and recorded traces; no new runtime replay, solver run, Unity tests, or human difficulty certification. Only documentation evidence is written.

method.input: Current manifest-100.json and all referenced layout/proof JSON; first ten resolved in Phase5R_TenLevelCandidates.
method.hash: SHA-256 of file bytes, compared with current manifest.
method.traceMetric: Mean of availableBefore[0:ceil(shipCount*0.6)] for each saved trace; verify against stored first60PercentMeanExits.
method.grouping: Levels 11-100 only, by manifest pace; all have 80 ships and 3 traces.
method.lowChoice: Count sampled prefix steps with <=2 direct exits, divided by total prefix steps; correlated recorded strategies, not player probabilities.
method.structureGates: Compare saved manifest features against current family thresholds, for every new level regardless of assigned family. Features are not recalculated by this audit.
